Ladies and gentlemen, I've known Jake since Year 7, when his biggest flex was a FIFA Ultimate Team pack and a Greggs sausage roll he refused to share.

He's survived Tube strikes, a situationship straight out of Love Island, and a 4am Nando's order that ended with him crying along to Stormzy.

Then Priya arrived: a woman who beats him at Wordle, out-dances him to Dua Lipa, and somehow gets him out of Peckham before midnight.

Priya, you've turned a man who swore he was "not a relationship person" into someone who says "we" in the group chat and shares a Spotify Wrapped with you.

He swore he'd never settle down, then Emma showed up, he deleted Hinge, and he's been more loyal than Atlanta was to the Braves in 2021, when he cried harder than he did at the Season 1 finale of *Atlanta*.

I sat on the bus yesterday listening to Biffy Clyro, genuinely wondering at what exact point my entire adult life went completely off the rails.
Then I walked into the local for a pint of Tennent's, and the barman asked if I was home from uni for the Easter break.

How y’all doing tonight? At forty-eight years old, I finally made it: I moved back in with my parents.
I went from paying a mortgage to getting an official H-E-B chore list and a mandatory 10 PM curfew.

But the ultimate hit to my dignity isn't losing my freedom; it's knowing my parents are out making midnight Buc-ee's runs while I'm fast asleep by nine.
